name: read
description: Read a file's contents as UTF-8 text. Each line is prefixed with its 1-based number and a tab; the prefix is not part of the file, so leave it out of an edit's old_string.{skeleton_note}

offset.description: First line to return, 1-based. Defaults to 1.

mode.description: Read mode: 'text' (default) or 'skeleton' (signatures and type definitions, bodies elided).
